caption: The four product basis states of two qubits, arranged by first qubit (row) and second qubit (column). The marked cell |00⟩ is the product |0⟩ ⊗ |0⟩; every state in the top row begins with |0⟩.

spec.title: Basis of C² ⊗ C²
spec.aria: A two-by-two table lists the four product basis states |00⟩, |01⟩, |10⟩ and |11⟩ with row labels |0⟩ and |1⟩.
